full_name: Cindy Hsin-Liu Kao | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Engineering & Computer Science Carl and Lily Pforzheimer Foundation Fellow Cornell University
bio: Cindy Hsin-Liu Kao is an associate professor at Cornell University and the founder and director of the Hybrid Body Lab, a transdisciplinary research group exploring cultural and social perspectives in the design of on-skin interfaces.
